newsitem.title: USA: Universal International gets credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Universal International gets credit pact.

text.p: Universal International Inc said Thursday that Coast Business Credit funded a new $14 million revolving credit facility, expiring in June, 1999.
The new credit facility replaces the previous $10 million line of credit and will be used for general corporate working capital needs.

"The new line of credit will provide the company with greater availability of funds to finance its working capital needs over the next two years," Mark Ravich, chief executive officer, said in statement.
Universal International also said that May sales for its Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's retail stores rose 26.4 percent to $4.8 million from $3.8 million a year ago.
Comparable store sales were up 1.9 percent in May, but were down 2.4 percent for the first five months of the year.
